General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Oil Dip Stick for the Suzuki G13A (Samurai 86-89) & G13BA (Samurai 90-95) engines.
Will also fit the Suzuki G16A (Sidekick 89-94 & Tracker 89-94) engine.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Dip Stick
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1986 – 1995 (Carb & EFI)
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1994 (1.6L w/ 8 Valve)
Geo Tracker 1989 – 1994 (1.6L w/ 8 Valve)
Suzuki Swift 1989 – 1997
Geo Metro 1992 – 1997
Subaru Justy 1994 – 2004
